title: With William Benbow at the Frolic Theatre; backing the blues queens
summary: With Benbow's company at the Frolic, aged seventeen or eighteen, he accompanied Bessie Smith, Ida Cox, Ma Rainey and other blues singers before 1920.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Oh, okay. But before you were with Clarence Muse, you were with who? You said you left the Old Kentucky Minstrels in South Carolina...
And then you moved on to another show, apparently. Another minstrel troupe?
Okay. Now, you were still a teenager at this time...
That was also at the Frolic Theatre.
I see. This was in Birmingham, Alabama.
You weren't twenty years old then...
No, I was around eighteen years old, something around there. Seventeen or eighteen years old.
But then we got into the Frolie Theatre. That's how I come to play behind Bessie Smith, Ida Cox, Sarah Martin, Ma Rainey, and all the old-time Blues singers. Butterbeans and Suzie. Ashes(?)...
